output.summary: A biennial flowering plant native to Europe and western Asia. It has coarse, deeply lobed spiny leaves covered in white woolly hairs and conspicuous spiny-winged stems, with dark pink to lavender flower heads. Its flower receptacle was formerly eaten like an artichoke, and seed oil has been used for cooking.
